notes: GST general-sector rate 8% (GST Act s.16; MIRA) - retail gold is general sector, not the 16-17% tourism sector. Bullion: the s.20 exempt list and Schedule 1 zero-rated list were read in full; the Act contains no gold mention, so bullion takes 8%. Import duty (MFN, National Tariff 2026): gold 7108.12 unwrought = 25% (powder/semi-manufactured 0%); silver 7106 unwrought = 25%.

sources.name: Maldives Inland Revenue Authority (mira.gov.mv) - GST FAQ and GST Act 10/2011
sources.what: Read 2026-11-28: the general-sector GST rate is 8% from 1 January 2023; the Act's exempt and zero-rated lists contain no gold

sources.name: Maldives Customs Service (customs.gov.mv) - Maldives National Tariff 2026
sources.what: Read 2026-11-28: HS 7108.12 other unwrought forms carry an MFN duty of 25%
